headline: Not the Economic Conditions, This Is the Specter That Caused 17 Indonesian Banks to Close Together
summary: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) has revoked the licences of 17 rural banks (BPR) up to November 2026. The report attributes the closures to factors other than the broader economic conditions.
why: OJK supervises Indonesia's banking and financial sectors, and licence revocations affect depositors, local credit supply and confidence in smaller lenders.
original_headline: Bukan Kondisi Ekonomi, Ini Momok yang Bikin 17 Bank RI Tutup Berjamaah
